mainEntity.name: Do you hire freshers for automation testing roles in Indore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We have specific openings for freshers who are interested in QA and want to build automation skills from the ground up. You'll be mentored by experienced engineers.

acceptedAnswer.text: A degree in computer science, IT, or a related field is preferred, but not strictly required if you can demonstrate relevant skills. Practical knowledge matters more than degree.

text: Looking for Automation Testing Jobs in Indore? Join UltraModern Technologies and work on real-world web applications, mobile apps, APIs, and enterprise software using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman, and modern QA tools. Freshers and experienced QA engineers are welcome to apply.

sections.title: QA is not a checkpoint. It's a design input.

items: Most software teams treat QA as a checkpoint. We treat it as a design input. The difference shows up in small ways. When developers come to us early in a sprint to ask "how should we make this testable?" instead of "why did QA reject this?"that's the culture we've built. Our QA engineers sit in sprint planning, not just sprint reviews.

Indore's IT sector has expanded fast over the last few years. More companies, more products, more pressure to ship. But shipping fast without a solid test layer is just accumulating problems you'll pay for later. We've seen what bad QA does to a codebase and we've done the work of building something better.
If you've been looking for QA automation engineer jobs where your work directly influences product decisions, this is worth reading.

items.title: What You'll Be Testing
text: No two sprints look the same. You won't be writing the same login test for three years.

sections.title: Automation Testing is one of the fastest-growing IT career paths in India

items: Businesses need QA professionals who can improve software quality, reduce bugs, and speed up product releases. At UltraModern Technologies, automation testers work with real projects, modern testing tools, and experienced development teams.

items.title: You understand what you're testing
text: Not just writing scripts understanding user flow, business logic, and where things break. This separates good testers from people who write tests that always pass.

items.title: Maintainable test code
text: Clean structure, clear naming, sensible use of page object models. Tests that nobody can understand six months later are a liability.

items.title: Clear bug communication
text: Isolate the problem, describe steps, give devs what they need to fix it. "It didn't work" helps nobody.

items.title: Version control comfortable
text: If you've never made a commit or opened a pull request, that's something to work on before applying.

items.title: For Freshers & Experienced QA Engineers
text: Freshers: We don't expect production experience. We expect genuine curiosity and a willingness to learn. If you've done personal projects, ISTQB prep, or testing practice on open-source apps, mention that.
Experienced QA engineers: We want people who've moved beyond manual testing and have real automation work to show even side projects count.

items: You don't need to know all of these on day one. But you should know at least one automation tool well enough to write real tests with it.

sections.title: Automation Testing Jobs in Indore – FAQs

items.q: Do you hire freshers for automation testing roles in Indore?
items.a: Yes. We have specific openings for freshers who are interested in QA and want to build automation skills from the ground up. You'll be mentored by experienced engineers and won't be left to figure things out alone.

items.q: What is the minimum qualification required to apply?
items.a: A degree in computer science, IT, or a related field is preferred, but not strictly required if you can demonstrate relevant skills. Practical knowledge matters more than your degree.

items.q: Do I need to know Selenium before joining?
items.a: Familiarity with Selenium or another automation tool is preferred for most roles. For entry-level positions, we're open to candidates who have covered the basics through coursework or self-study.

items.q: Is there a training period for new QA hires?
items.a: Yes. Freshers go through a structured onboarding period before taking independent ownership. You'll work alongside a senior tester first.

items.q: What programming languages do your automation testers use?
items.a: Primarily Java and JavaScript. Some Playwright and Cypress work is done in TypeScript. Python is used occasionally for scripting and data setup.

items.q: What is the difference between manual testing and automation testing?
items.a: Automation testing uses tools like Selenium, Cypress, and Playwright to execute test cases automatically, while manual testing requires human execution. Automation improves efficiency, speed, and test coverage.

items.q: Which automation testing tools should freshers learn?
items.a: Freshers should start with Selenium, Postman, Cypress, Playwright, Git, and basic programming in Java or JavaScript.

items.q: Is automation testing a good career in India?
items.a: Yes. Automation testing is one of the most in-demand IT skills because companies need faster software releases with fewer bugs.

items.q: Do automation testers need coding skills?
items.a: Basic coding knowledge is highly recommended. Languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, and TypeScript are commonly used in automation testing.
